name: fb_instant_games
summary: Server-side Python companion to the Facebook Instant Games JavaScript SDK (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/games/build/instant-games/sdk/). The JS SDK runs inside the FB-embedded iframe (Messenger / News Feed) and POSTs every meaningful surface action back to the studio dApp at /dapp/api/fb_event with a bearer freetier token. This connector (a) records every event into ~/.cc/fb_instant_events.jsonl, (b) crystal-anchors each event via inference_logger.log(tier='fb_event', model='fb_instant_games', scope=f'fb_event_<event_name>'), (c) verifies the signed_player_info HMAC against FB_APP_SECRET so we can trust player_id, and (d) when event_name=='instant.friends.list_pulled' hands the friends payload off to the facebook_friends_graph harvester (agent B) for social-graph persistence. The SDK_MANIFEST constant documents 21 FBInstant JS calls (js_call → server_event_name + scope_required + body_schema + description) so the Godot HTML5 build and the studio dApp know what to wire to which event. Stdlib-only (urllib, hmac, hashlib, json, base64). Sibling to facebook_games_sdk.py which is the outbound Graph API REST connector — this companion is purely inbound (event sink, no graph.facebook.com HTTP calls).
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass with SERVICE='fb_instant_games'. Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args). connect() probes only env vars (no network) and returns True iff FB_APP_ID + FB_APP_SECRET both present — connect status drives whether signed_player_info verification can run, but record_event still works without keys (signed_valid=False). signed_player_info verification is a pure stdlib hmac.compare_digest over `<sig>.<payload>` base64url tokens with HMAC-SHA256(app_secret, payload). Friends-list hand-off is wrapped in try/except so this module is useful before agent B is installed.

sdk_manifest_schema_per_entry.js_call: exact FBInstant.* signature the in-browser JS SDK should invoke
sdk_manifest_schema_per_entry.scope_required: FB permission scope the player must have granted (or 'none')
sdk_manifest_schema_per_entry.server_event_name: the dotted event_name the dApp callback POSTs back to /dapp/api/fb_event
sdk_manifest_schema_per_entry.body_schema: expected POST body keys + types (for the dApp + Godot HTML5 build)

env_vars.FB_APP_ID: Facebook App ID (developers.facebook.com/apps → App Settings → Basic). Drives connect() status.
env_vars.FB_APP_SECRET: Facebook App Secret. Required to verify signed_player_info HMACs; absent → signed_valid=False on every record.

user_provisioning_required.status: SHARED WITH facebook_games_sdk — same FB_APP_ID + FB_APP_SECRET
user_provisioning_required.rationale: Both connectors read the SAME pair of env vars. Provisioning either provisions both. No additional .env keys needed for fb_instant_games specifically.

convenience_wrappers: record_event(event_name, player_id, context_id, signed_data, payload)  — primary entry; called by the JS SDK via the dApp /dapp/api/fb_event POST. Crystal anchor + JSONL sink + friends_list_pulled hand-off.
verify_signed_data(signed_player_info, fb_app_secret)  — verify the FB-issued HMAC. Returns {valid, player_id, request_payload, issued_at, error?}. Pure stdlib hmac.
manifest()  — returns the SDK_MANIFEST (21 entries). Consumed by studio/dapp + Godot HTML5 build to know which JS calls to wire to which server events.
event_stats(since_ts=None)  — counts events in ~/.cc/fb_instant_events.jsonl by event_name; returns {total, by_event_name, first_ts, last_ts}.

FBInstantGamesConnector.verify_dapp_token(token, expected_domain=None)  — staticmethod wrapper around freetier_gate.verify_token for the dApp handler to bearer-gate every /dapp/api/fb_event POST in one call.

shape_per_line.ts: float — unix seconds at record_event time
shape_per_line.player_id: str  — FB-scoped player ID (or '' if anon)
shape_per_line.signed_valid: bool — True iff signed_player_info HMAC verified
shape_per_line.payload_summary: dict — redacted summary of the JS-side payload

friends_harvest_handoff.wiring: wrapped in try/except — if agent B is not yet installed, record_event still succeeds with metadata.friends_handoff={status:'deferred', error:'<ImportError>'} and the friends payload is preserved in the event-sink JSONL for later replay.

inbound_callers: studio/dapp/server.py → POST /dapp/api/fb_event (JS SDK callback; bearer freetier token required)
Godot HTML5 build → same /dapp/api/fb_event surface (in-game events)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: FB_APP_ID + FB_APP_SECRET via studio/auth/keys.load_env (mirrored .env between /data/Projects/MySpace++/.env and /data/Projects/gently/.env)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: fb_instant_events.jsonl (event sink) + send_log entries + crystal_chain fb_event records

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.connect: expected_false — FB_APP_ID + FB_APP_SECRET absent from .env (user provisioning pending; same pair as facebook_games_sdk)
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.record_event: ok — crystal_id=0fb6829699e49f5e… on a fake 'instant.initialized' event; event_sink JSONL appended
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.verify_signed_data_round_trip: ok — self-generated <sig>.<payload> verified True; wrong secret → signature_mismatch; 'not_a_dot_string' → malformed
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.friends_handoff: deferred — facebook_friends_graph.ingest_friends_list import fails until agent B exports it; record_event still succeeds with metadata.friends_handoff.status='deferred'

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every record_event() call appends one InferenceRecord with tier='fb_event', model='fb_instant_games', scope='fb_event_<event_name>'
Stdlib-only — urllib, hmac, hashlib, json, base64. No facebook-sdk, no requests.
Graceful — missing FB_APP_SECRET → signed_valid=False on every record_event but the event is still recorded + crystal-anchored
Redacted logs — signature, signed_data, signedPlayerInfo, access_token, purchase_token, developerPayload stripped from crystal payloads + event-sink summaries
HMAC-verified identity — verify_signed_data(signed_player_info, fb_app_secret) uses hmac.compare_digest for constant-time comparison; never raises
Friends-handoff deferable — agent B may not exist yet; record_event always succeeds and the friends payload is preserved in the JSONL sink
Bearer-gateable — FBInstantGamesConnector.verify_dapp_token wraps freetier_gate.verify_token so /dapp/api/fb_event is one-call gated
Surface-documented — SDK_MANIFEST has 21 entries; every entry includes js_call + server_event_name + scope_required + body_schema + description
usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.fb_instant_games import FBInstantGamesConnector
c = FBInstantGamesConnector()
c.connect()
# In studio/dapp/server.py POST /dapp/api/fb_event handler:
if not FBInstantGamesConnector.verify_dapp_token(bearer_token):
    return 401
r = c.send('record_event', json.dumps({
    'event_name': 'instant.player.id_read',
    'player_id':  request_json['player_id'],
    'context_id': request_json.get('context_id', 'SOLO'),
    'signed_data': request_json.get('signed_data', ''),
    'payload':    request_json.get('payload', {}),
}))
return {'ok': r.success, 'crystal': r.crystal_id}
